limitations: model_id is unverified because the runtime machine model ID was unavailable to this matcher context.
Matching was performed by a single matcher context with gold access; no second matcher or adjudicator reviewed these decisions.
Where a claim described replacing problematic content with corrective content, only one concept could be recorded per claim; the discarded reading is noted in the rationale where it was close.
Turn-local gold concepts defined only in concept_definitions were matched as semantic, never exact or alias, since they carry no ontology entry.
No claim had text identical to its evidence_span, so no exact or alias match was available under the deterministic rule.
Machine model ID was unavailable from cloud run metadata; no ID was guessed.
Transcript audit disposition is recorded in matcher-protocol-audits.json.
